flags.message: The forecast relies decisively on the provisioned petition and respondent response describing the June 25, 2026 Durnell decision, and on the respondent's express nonopposition to GVR. This is pre-snapshot companion-case evidence, not retrieval of Dennis's own disposition. The companion opinion was not independently fetched. The file named brief-in-opposition.txt is substantively an unopposed-GVR response.
